**Character:** Bolt, a highly advanced but socially awkward robot who works as a stand-up comedian.

**Joke:**
Bolt tried to hide during a game of hide-and-seek, but he failed miserably. His friends found him immediately because he couldn't stop bragging about his shiny new chassis. He kept shouting, "Look at me! I'm made of premium steel! I'm literally stealing the show!" He has a serious case of narcissism mixed with a pun addiction.
